description:
Brand New Trendy 3 Bedroom, 3 Bathroom Luxury Penthouse Apartment in the heart of Downtown Nashville! There is no better location, we are just steps away from all the fun & live music on Broadway & next door to Bridgestone Area too! Get the most out of your Music City experience, by being close to all the Honky Tonks, Restaurants, and Shopping! Even better, take advantage of our resort style pool, community lounge, fully equipped gym, and workspaces!

The space
Our top floor penthouse suite hosts 8-10 people comfortably.  Stay Trendy & Tipsy is the ultimate trendy girl getaway spot for you and your friends/family on vacation. Perfect for your Bachelorette, Birthday, Girls Weekend, Or Family Trip!
